note: Restated Certificate of Incorporation (EX-3.1 to the Sept 30, 2021 8-K, effective on conversion to a Delaware PBC). Article IV pairs default any-lawful-act language with a bare statutory election ('shall be a public benefit corporation, as contemplated by subchapter XV of the DGCL') and a specific public benefit purpose (novel pharmaceutical therapies; technologies that expand the availability of transplantable organs). As with Vital Farms' EX-3.2 there is NO explicit balancing-of-interests sentence, so M3 rests on the statutory election alone and an answer must not invent balancing language. No elevated-vote provision of any kind, so Amendment Supermajority Requirements = 'No'.
